reason: A testing and debugging plugin that maps code changes to relevant tests, checks changed-line coverage, executes configured test commands, and invalidates evidence when the code changes.

summaries.zh: 在代码修改后关联相关测试、核对变更行覆盖率并记录可过期的验证结论。
summaries.en: Maps code changes to relevant tests, checks changed-line coverage, and records verification results that become stale when the code changes.

capabilities: Reads workspace source files, test files, configuration, and coverage artifacts
Analyzes code changes and related tests
Executes user-configured test commands as subprocesses
Stores verification evidence and reports verification status, including stale results
